Saved Views is available today, giving you a faster way to work with the lists and boards you use most. Instead of rebuilding filters, sorts, and grouping every time you open a project, you can now save your exact configuration and return to it instantly. This new capability is included in all paid plans, so every team on a paid subscription can start using it right away at no additional cost.

Each user can save up to 50 views, covering everything from a personal daily task list to a filtered view of overdue items across multiple projects. Views can also be shared with your team, making it easy to align on how work gets tracked and reviewed together. Once a view is shared, teammates see the same filters and sorting you set up, so everyone stays on the same page without extra setup.

We built Saved Views to help teams spend less time configuring and more time doing actual work. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
